# OneAlgorithm

> OneAlgorithm is a woman-owned technology and marketing company based in
> Malvern, Pennsylvania (Chester County, Philadelphia metro), working with
> clients across the United States. We build and market websites for small
> businesses — web development, SEO, Google Ads, marketing and CRM. As a listed
> Salesforce Consulting Partner we also deliver Salesforce, systems integration
> and staff augmentation nationally.

## About

- **Company name**: OneAlgorithm LLC (brand: OneAlgorithm Consulting)
- **Headquarters**: 625 Swedesford Rd, Unit B, Malvern, Pennsylvania 19355
- **Phone**: 1 (610) 890-9711
- **Website**: https://onealgorithm.com
- **Contact**: https://onealgorithm.com/contact
- **Certifications**: SBA-certified WOSB and EDWOSB; WBENC; NMSDC. Verify at
  https://search.certifications.sba.gov/profile/W8DYK38MEKP3/14G18
- **Identifiers**: UEI W8DYK38MEKP3 · CAGE 14G18 · D-U-N-S 118835343

## Services

- [Custom website design and development](https://onealgorithm.com/services/website-development): custom websites designed and built from our Malvern, PA office, with six live client sites shown on the page.
- [How much does a website cost](https://onealgorithm.com/services/website-cost): what sets the price of a custom website, with the scope and price in writing before work starts.
- [Small business website design](https://onealgorithm.com/services/small-business-website-design): websites for owner-led businesses, built to be found, explain the service and take the call, booking or order.
- [Website redesign](https://onealgorithm.com/services/website-redesign): a new design and code on your existing domain, with every old address redirected so rankings carry over.
- SEO: https://onealgorithm.com/services/seo

## Salesforce

OneAlgorithm is a Select Salesforce Consulting Partner on AppExchange (listing
a0N3A00000EV7SwUAL: 16 Salesforce-certified people, 53 certifications, 38 of
them Platform), working from Malvern, PA. Every page below offers the free
one-week Salesforce health check.

- Salesforce implementation services (hub): https://onealgorithm.com/services/salesforce
- Free one-week Salesforce health check: licenses, data, automation, permissions and integrations, in a written list ranked by what to fix first: https://onealgorithm.com/services/salesforce-health-check
